audit_log.table:
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	call_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	user VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	details TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

call_records.table:
CREATE TABLE call_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	call_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	audio_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	transcript_text TEXT, 
	summary_json TEXT, 
	qa_scores_json TEXT, 
	report_json TEXT, 
	processed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	trace_id VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_call_records_call_id ON call_records (call_id)

transcription_cache.table:
CREATE TABLE transcription_cache (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	audio_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	transcription_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_transcription_cache_audio_hash ON transcription_cache (audio_hash)
